title: Rodriguez v. United States (2015)
key_points: Holding: Police may not extend a completed traffic stop, even briefly, to conduct a dog sniff without reasonable suspicion.
officer_notes: Scenario: You finish writing a warning, then hold the driver seven minutes for a K-9 unit with no new suspicion.
Takeaway: Once the stop's mission is complete, release the driver unless you have independent reasonable suspicion.
